summary: Orange Pharmacy Staff Portal - Full E2E Testing Complete. Fixed critical route ordering bug in backend (/medicines/bulk-update was incorrectly matched by /medicines/{medicine_id}). All 15 backend API tests pass. All frontend UI tests pass.

fixed.issue: Route was defined AFTER /medicines/{medicine_id}, causing FastAPI to match 'bulk-update' as medicine_id, returning 404
fixed.fix: Moved bulk-update route BEFORE parameterized routes in orange_pharmacy.py. Also added discount_percent and stock_quantity fields to bulk update handler.

issues: Many products show MRP: ₹0 - likely seed data quality issue, not a code bug

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: FastAPI route ordering bug - /medicines/bulk-update must be defined BEFORE /medicines/{medicine_id}
OrangePharmacyStaffPortal.js is 883 lines - well-structured with proper data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Backend orange_pharmacy.py has proper auth checks with verify_pharmacy_staff dependency
Image search uses Pixabay API with fallback to placeholder images (API key may be rate limited)
Orders currently show 0 orders in DB - this is expected empty state, not a bug
seed_data_creation: Test created and deleted TEST_NewMedicine_* during CRUD test cycle
context_for_next_testing_agent: Orange Pharmacy Staff Portal fully tested. Fixed route ordering bug where bulk-update was matched as medicine_id. All CRUD operations on medicines work. Dashboard shows 500 products, 0 orders (empty state). Image search returns placeholders (Pixabay API key limitation). Test credentials: staff_orange / test1234.
